headline: Chip-gear prices spike as UK coal all but disappears
text:
# Chip-gear prices spike as UK coal all but disappears

Seven records at once: US electronics factory prices, Austrian bills and pharma output, UK coal near zero, Estonian car sales halved.

## Today in the data

### US electronics prices break out
[US computer & electronics factory-gate prices vs chip output](https://namikakmandev.github.io/chart.html#)
Today's note has us-ppi-sectors computer_electronic up 12.9% on the year in Aug 2026; the copy I can query ends 2026-07 at 118.276, from 114.968 in Feb 2026. Look at the step up after 2026-03 against a flat decade. Caveat: BLS base periods differ by series, so only ratios and growth rates mean anything here.

### Austrian household power up a third
[Household electricity prices, Austria and Luxembourg, EUR/kWh](https://namikakmandev.github.io/chart.html#)
energy-household-eu: Austria 0.3272 EUR/kWh in H2 2025, up 34.3% on H2 2024, the largest rise since 2008; Luxembourg 0.2665, up 31.7%. Look at how both jump from a 2024 trough rather than from the 2022-23 peak. Caveat: taxes and levies are included, so an expiring subsidy shows up as a price rise — worth checking against national relief measures.

### Austrian pharma output halves
[Austrian pharma production against total manufacturing, 2021=100](https://namikakmandev.github.io/chart.html#)
eu-ipi-sectors AT|C21 is 160.4 in Jul 2026 per today's note, 45.7% below Jul 2025 — the sharpest fall since 2011; the queryable copy ends 161 in Jun 2026 against manufacturing at 102.2. Look at the 295 spike in mid-2025 that the base effect works against. Caveat: pharma batch production makes this index extremely lumpy month to month.

### UK coal generation reaches zero
[UK electricity: coal's last terawatt-hours against wind, solar and gas](https://namikakmandev.github.io/chart.html#)
electricity-mix GB|coal: 0.33 TWh in 2025, down 82.6% from 1.9 TWh in 2024, the sharpest fall in a record starting 1921. Look at wind at 85.84 TWh, now within 6 TWh of gas at 90.91. Caveat: Ember's last year is often provisional, and this is generation, not consumption, so imports are excluded.

### Estonian car market halves
[New car registrations in Estonia by fuel](https://namikakmandev.github.io/chart.html#)
eu-car-registrations: Estonia's total fell 49% to 13,141 cars in 2025, diesel 70% to 1,738, both records since 2014; petrol was 10,531 and battery electric 872. Look at how the drop is broad, not a switch between fuels. Caveat: a twelve-year annual series, and registrations can be pulled forward by tax changes — worth checking against Estonia's 2025 car tax.

### Greek power now 61% renewable
[Greece: renewable share of electricity and of final energy](https://namikakmandev.github.io/chart.html#)
eu-renewables-share EL|REN_ELC: 60.9% in 2025, up 9.65 points on 2024, the biggest annual gain since 2005; the all-energy share is 26.9%. Look at the gap between the two lines — electricity runs far ahead of heat and transport. Caveat: these are Renewable Energy Directive accounting rules, not Ember generation shares, so the two collections will not match.

### Egypt's FDI drops 31 billion dollars
[Egypt: net FDI inflows, current US dollars, since 1971](https://namikakmandev.github.io/chart.html#)
macro-external EG|fdi_net_inflow_usd: 15.45bn in 2025 against 46.58bn in 2024, a 31.1bn fall, the sharpest since 1971. Look at the single 2024 spike the fall is measured from. Caveat: current dollars, World Bank vintages lag one to two years, so 2025 may be revised.

## Forecasts

### Electronics prices keep climbing into autumn
[us-ppi-sectors:computer_electronic forecast](https://namikakmandev.github.io/chart.html#)
Last observation in the queryable copy: 118.276 in Jul 2026 (us-ppi-sectors). The tool chose Holt-Winters additive, period 12, fitting the past with a 0.28% mean absolute error, and puts Oct 2026 at 120.42 with a 95% band of 118.96 to 121.88. The band is only the spread of past residuals widened with the horizon, not a statement about tariffs or chip contracts. Today's note already has 120.048 for Aug 2026, above the forecast path's Aug point — a sign the series is accelerating faster than its own history implies.

### Austrian bills drift sideways near record
[energy-household-eu:AT forecast](https://namikakmandev.github.io/chart.html#)
Last observation: 0.3272 EUR/kWh in H2 2025 (energy-household-eu). Holt-Winters additive, period 2, with a 3.3% in-sample error, gives 0.3150 for H1 2026 and 0.3249 for H2 2026, band 0.2904 to 0.3594. The band is past half-year surprises carried forward. This is a tax-inclusive regulated bill, so the projection is of its own history, not of policy: a new levy, a subsidy or a network-tariff decision would take it outside the band.

### Austrian pharma output too erratic to call
[eu-ipi-sectors:AT|C21 forecast](https://namikakmandev.github.io/chart.html#)
Last observation in the queryable copy: 161 in Jun 2026 (eu-ipi-sectors, 2021=100). Holt-Winters additive, period 12, with a 4.97% in-sample error and a residual spread of 11.8 index points, gives 166.2 for Sep 2026 with a band of 126.2 to 206.3. That band is wider than most of the level's own range, which is the honest reading of a lumpy batch-production series. The note's 160.4 for Jul 2026 already sits below the Jul forecast of 176.8.

## Correlations

- **Austria vs Luxembourg household electricity** (yoy, 2008-S2 to 2025-S2, n=35): r = 0.53 at lag 0, and 0.61 with Luxembourg one half-year earlier — both clear the widened band. Small connected markets repricing together, so the Austrian record is regional, not purely national.
- **US electronics PPI vs semiconductor output** (yoy, 2012-01 to 2026-07, n=175): r = 0.01 at lag 0, strongest 0.14 at lag 12, not distinguishable from zero. The price jump is not tracking volumes in this sample, so read it as a cost or mix story.

## What to watch

- us-ppi-sectors: the Sep 2026 print settles whether the electronics breakout is one quarter or a trend.
- eu-ipi-sectors: Austria's Aug 2026 pharma figure shows whether Jul's 160.4 was a base effect or a level shift.
- cpi-eu and eu-hicp (last 2026-07): whether higher household power is reaching consumer indices.
- us-chips (last 2026-07): semiconductor IP will say if volumes catch up with prices.
- cattle-parity, cattle-tr and cattle-eu (last 2026-08): the next agricultural block due in the collection.

## Sources

- us-ppi-sectors — BLS producer price indexes by NAICS industry via FRED, monthly NSA; queryable to 2026-07 (note cites 2026-08).
- us-chips — Federal Reserve industrial production via FRED (NAICS 3344, 334), monthly SA; last 2026-07.
- energy-household-eu — Eurostat nrg_pc_204, band DC, all taxes included; last 2025-S2.
- eu-ipi-sectors — Eurostat sts_inpr_m, 2021=100, SCA; queryable to 2026-06 (note cites 2026-07).
- electricity-mix — Ember Yearly Electricity Data and Energy Institute, via Our World in Data; last 2025.
- eu-car-registrations — Eurostat road_eqr_carpda; last 2025.
- eu-renewables-share — Eurostat nrg_ind_ren; last 2025.
- macro-external — World Bank World Development Indicators; last 2025.
